author: Jessica Cogswell
description:
The ambitious life-simulation game InZoi was once heralded as a potential "Sims-killer"--a promising new title that fans of the genre could turn to following EA's relentless pursuit to monetize every aspect of The Sims 4. However, a lackluster early-access period and concerns over the game's liberal use of AI made for a rocky start. Over the past year and a half, developer Krafton has addressed some of the complaints leveled at the game, but now, it finds itself in hot water for a different reason.

Earlier today, the official InZoi X account
title: Sims Competitor InZoi Deletes “Uncomfortable” Post After Fan Pushback

author: Ben Janca
description: From its wuxia roots to its unique difficulty options, here is everything to know about Phantom Blade Zero.
title: Phantom Blade Zero – Everything To Know

author: Reyna Cervantes
description: For many of us, the weather is finally becoming that cool autumn crisp, the days are getting shorter, and the season for gorging on candy and horror movies is in full-swing. While I may be in the camp that believes there aren’t nearly enough vampire video games, these creatures of the night are well represented in games. So what better time to pay tribute to our favorite bloodsuckers? Show off those pearly white fangs; these are the best vampires in gaming:
title: Fangs For The Memories: The Best Vampires In Video Games

author: Jade King
description:
Friendslop is everywhere these days. Take one glance at the most recent Steam Next Fest and you’ll be inundated with not only mountains of obnoxious AI slop, but countless games where you and a group of friends can get up to wacky hijinks with cartoonish avatars, over the top physics, and hilarious use of proximity chat. If you’re a developer and your take on this genre goes viral, it has a chance of attracting tens of thousands of players and being a massive financial success--it’s no surprise that friendslop has become so commonplace.

But if you fancy gaming on your lonesome for once or sadly don’t have any friends but still want to embrace the chaos of friendslop, then the latest game
title: Leave It To Double Fine To Make The First Single-Player Friendslop Game

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 released today, October 23, and the game's first DLC pack is available now. In keeping with Call of Duty tradition, the day-one DLC is a Call of Duty Endowment (CODE) pack, with proceeds going to Activision's charity that supports military veterans find new jobs after they leave the service.

The CODE Valor Pack adds the real-life Medal of Honor recipient Kyle Carpenter to the game as a playable character.

Carpenter was in Marjah, Afghanistan, when, on November 21, 2010, he put himself in front of a grenade to help save the life of his fellow Marine, N
title: Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’s First DLC Is Out Now,  Honors A Real Soldier Who Sustained Gruesome Injuries

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Prolific and veteran gaming actor Jennifer Hale, who is known for voicing Commander Shepard in the Mass Effect series, has reacted to the closure of BioWare and the cancellation of the next game in the series. After footage of the new project, Mass Effect Universe, was released, Hale said, "It's extraordinary."

She added: "I’m holding hope for magic to happen. This community and you incredible vevs deserve that and more."

A
title: Shepard Actor Reacts To Leaked Mass Effect Trailer,  Is “Holding Hope” The Game Will Live On

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
After news broke that EA would be shutting down BioWare, more details on the studio's in-development Mass Effect have begun to trickle out. A trailer for Mass Effect Universe hinted that the next game in the series would have a completely different tone, moving away from the galactic warfare that defined the first three games and toward covert ops, espionage, and the occasional barroom shootout. Gaming content creator and YouTuber Dantics has shed more light on the game, describing it as a Mass Effect game for the fans.

Known for his lore videos, including several on Mass Effect, Dantics says he was part of a private "Mass Effect Council," a community
title: The Next Mass Effect Sounded Like John Wick In Space

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Dead by Daylight features dozens of characters, including many licensed heroes and villains from beloved horror franchises, but every once in a while, some of them get delisted. Behaviour Interactive has revealed that Chucky will soon suffer such a fate; he's being delisted on November 24 at 8 AM PT / 11 AM ET. Until then, players can grab him and any related cosmetics on sale.

Chucky, whose in-game nickname is The Good Guy, debuted in Dead by Daylight in November 2023. Like all characters, he came with three unique perks, all of which will stay in the game after he's gone, Behaviour said.

Anyone who has purchased Chucky will retain access to him, as well as any of his alternate skins, like the Tiffany alternate skin voiced by Jennifer Tilly and based on Chucky's wife, Tiffany. For players who own the Chucky DLC, his perks will keep their established names, while anyone who doesn't
title: Dead By Daylight Delistings Continue As Developer Reveals It Must F**k With The Chuck

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Modern Warfare 4 has fully released, and there are plenty of new guns and attachments to unlock for this new year of Call of Duty. In this guide, we'll suggest some recommended weapon builds, so you can see exactly which guns and attachments you'll want to focus on unlocking and leveling up early.

Call of Duty's Gunsmith feature returns in Modern Warfare 4. This customization system lets you create five-attachment builds for multiplayer. In addition to the standard five attachments, you can also include the gun's unique Apex attachment.

Apex attachments are special add-ons you can unlock for each gun, which will drastically change how the weapon is used. Apex attachments are similar to the weapon conversion kits found in the recent Call of Duty games, but in Modern Warfare 4 they don't cost one of your attachment slots.

Apex attachments aren’t un
title: Best Loadouts In Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Modern Warfare 4 is live with Call of Duty's new DMZ extraction mode, where scavenging guns, equipment, and resources is crucial to survival. In this guide, we'll suggest a wide range of locations where you'll have a good opportunity to loot valuable resources, guns, keys, and even have a chance at one of DMZ's rare weapon manuals.

Hajin has 13 main points-of-interest, but some POIs are going to offer more valuab
title: CoD: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ – Best Hot Spots And Loot Locations

author: Cameron Koch
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever's layering system will receive some significant improvements for launch, according to a statement provided to GameSpot from Blizzard.

Layering, for the uninitiated, is a behind-the-scenes system in WoW: Forever that essentially creates and runs new versions (or layers) of the world as needed, all running simultaneously on top of one another. According to Blizzard, players in WoW: Forever are assigned a layer based on various criteria, like familiar players and friends, language, and PvP balance. Grouping up with a player or friend who is on another layer will transport you to the same layer so you can interact.

There are some pros to this system. It makes completing quests easier (since there's less competition for quests items and enemies) and the world far less crowded. It also helps performance, as anytime there are thousands of players in a concentrate
title: WoW: Forever’s Divisive Layering Will See Major Improvements For Launch, Blizzard Says

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Control Resonant is delightfully weird: a sequel that isn't afraid to fly its freak flag as it pits you against all manner of supernatural phenomena wreaking havoc on Manhattan. But between bosses that resemble Francis Bacon-inspired nightmare fuel and other spooky occurrences, The Board is undoubtedly the scene-stealer of Control Resonant--and that's without you even seeing them! 

The Board is louder than ever as it accompanies Dylan Faden in Remedy's new game, seemingly trapped in the powerful shape-shifting artifact that he uses to smash his way through The Hiss and The Patterning. A successful run elicits booming words of encouragement/motivation/incentive from the paranatural entities that make up The Board, each interaction being the equivalent of a shotgun blast of indecipherable bass that'll tickle your audio receptors.
title: Your Mind Is Playing Tricks On You: Why You Hear What You Want To Hear In Control Resonant

author: Michael Leri
description:
Biddy Blas could probably use a booster cushion on his speeder to see more clearly over its handlebars, but he hasn't needed any sort of booster to make a massive impression on the internet. 

This squat, reptilian nuisance from Star Wars: Galactic Racer has overtaken social media algorithms with a ceaseless flood of fan-made skits, memes, and thirst traps. Blas and his shrill Huttese barks have acted almost as unexpected marketing for the game, seemingly having a greater reach and impact than the smattering of high review scores. And like a podracer barreling down the Mos Espa Raceway, it has all come at Richard Summers-Calvert, the voice behind the Crocin racer, incredibly
title: In A (Biddy) Blas Of Glory: How Star Wars: Galactic Racer’s Smallest Racer Made Such A Huge Impact

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Saber Interactive's driving game Rideshare Stimulator has already made headlines for all the wrong reasons. But while its use of AI and the allegations from a former writer have attracted plenty of attention, Rideshare Stimulator has a far more fundamental problem to overcome: being an enjoyable game to play.

You're put in the driver's seat of a rideshare business that you co-own with your buddy, Tim. You'll have to pick up a variety of passengers, navigate traffic (and adhere to the usual rules of the road) and earn enough money to keep the business running. It has the potential to be a pretty fun gameplay loop, especially when there's an ongoing side mission to restore an old sports car housed in your garage. Unfortunately, the more Rideshare Stimulator attempts to simulate the realities of the job, the less appealing it becomes.
title: Rideshare Stimulator’s Biggest Problem Isn’t AI, It’s That The Game Just Isn’t Very Good

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Battlefield Studios is reportedly cancelling plans for a Mass Effect collaboration in Battlefield 6 in the wake of EA's decision to close BioWare and cancel the next game in the sci-fi series.

Fans discovered various Mass Effect-themed cosmetics in Battlefield 6's files, with many speculating that they would be released in November, tied to the Mass Effect N7 Day holiday on November 7.

Those cosmetics, which included Mass Effect-themed weapon charms and patches, have seemingly now been removed from Battlefield 6's in-game store prior to their general ava
title: Battlefield 6 Reportedly Cancels Mass Effect Collab In Wake Of BioWare Closure

author: Evan Campbell
description:
We're just weeks away from Grand Theft Auto VI launching, and you might think you're set to spend hours upon hours in the open-world game right now. But PureGym asks if your body is actually ready like former Nintendo of America president Reggie Fils-Aime's--as well as your thumbs. 

With that in mind, the fitness company has shared three thumb workouts from personal trainer David Hope to help prep you for GTA VI. These exercises are meant as a warm-up before picking up your controller, by the way. The first is just tapping your thumb with each finger on the same hand, which as a personal aside, can be a good mindfulness technique, too.
title: Finger Out How To Prep For GTA 6 With These Exercises

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
It might be the end of the road for Marvel's Blade developer Arkane Lyon, as a new report says that the studio has until November 13 to find a buyer or face closure.

Le Monde reported that while Microsoft had followed the procedure as laid out in Florange Law--French legislation that requires Microsoft to spend at least three months searching for a buyer for Arkane Lyon--negotiations were going "badly," and worker unions are current
title: Arkane Lyon Could Be Shut Down Within Weeks As Deadline To Find A Buyer Looms

author: Callum Self
description:
Saints Row’s 2022 reboot was, well, a flop. It didn’t have the fun or the charm of the classic games in the series, and while the world was waiting for GTA 6, it should’ve been the lightning-in-a-bottle moment to reignite the love for the dormant Saints. While it didn’t work out, Saints Row: The Third Remastered is still a classic, and you should buy it while you wait for the Grand Theft Auto 6 release date to roll around, especially when it’s under $5.

Before GTA V took the world by storm, Saints Row: The Third blew my mind. It had the same “running a gang” vibe that the Grand Theft Auto games delivered, but with a focus on adding a zany, whimsical charm to what should’ve been serious. You play as a custom character known as The Boss, who lands in Steelport and is forced to deal with the Syndicate and three of its div
title: The Wait For GTA 6 Feels Like A Crime, So Grab This Excellent Alternative For Less Than $4

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar Games and the burger company Skinny Louie have announced a partnership to promote GTA 6, during which its stores will convert to Burger Shots through the end of the year. Burger Shot is the Burger King parody in the world of GTA.

People in South Florida can buy GTA 6 burgers at the Kaseya Center, and also every Skinny Louie
title: GTA 6 Burgers Will Be Available In Florida Throughout The Year

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Video game adaptations are all the rage right now, with movie and TV projects in various stages of development, and Netflix is looking to strike while the proverbial IP iron is hot. The streaming giant already has a deal in place with Microsoft to develop a Gears of War movie, and it's looking to grab more Xbox IP to build new franchises. The only problem? Microsoft's price tag was reportedly quite a bit more than Netflix was willing to pay.

That's according to entertainment journalist Matthew Belloni, who wrote in a Puck News report that Netflix had offered Microsoft $500 million for seven years to exclusively license
title: Xbox Wanted A Gargantuan Paycheck To Partner With Netflix On TV And Movies

author: Eddie Makuch
description: Electronic Arts just confirmed a major shakeup that included the closure of BioWare and cancellation of its upcoming Mass Effect game. Closing the studio and cancelling the project was a horrible thing for the people who worked there and fans who enjoy BioWare games and were
title: Cancelling Mass Effect And Closing BioWare Was An Obvious Thing For EA To Do, Experts Say

author: Jade King
description:
BioWare was shuttered by Electronic Arts earlier this week, resulting in 50 or so people losing their jobs and the upcoming Mass Effect 5 being cancelled. While the studio’s last decade of struggles have been frequently documented as games like Mass Effect Andromeda, Anthem, and Dragon Age: The Veilguard failed to live up to expectations, there nevertheless existed an optimism among fans that the magic would return. Much of this fainthearted hope rested on Mass Effect 5, a game many believed would right the studio's wrongs and pull this architect of modern RPGs away from the brink of oblivion. But I was wrong. Now BioWare is no more, and it breaks my heart. 

Like millions of others, I grew up with Mass Effect and
title: BioWare Is No More, But Its Impact On Queer Representation In Video Games Will Live On Forever

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Just what is The Board in Control Resonant? While we still have plenty of questions about the otherworldly entity that accompanies players on their trip across Manhattan, one thing we do know is that it's loud, incomprehensible, and you can't understand what it's saying without subtitles. Some players are convinced The Board is saying something specific if you listen closely, but according to developer Remedy Entertainment, it's a little audio trick that makes you hear what you want to hear.

In an upcoming interview with GameSpot, audio lead Lucas Pierrot explained that The Board speaks "gibberish," making the character open to interpretation.
title: Control Resonant’s Unsettling Board Dialogue Is Carefully Crafted Gibberish

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
When a big new first-party game comes to Xbox, Microsoft is known to put up big, annoying takeover ads, and that trend continues this year with the launch of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. Things are a little different, and more annoying, this year.

People who booted up their Xbox today, the day of MW4's release, noticed that not only is there a big MW4 takeover ad, but the ad even hijacks your custom background.
title: Call Of Duty Ads On Xbox Are Even More Annoying This Year With Modern Warfare 4

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
As if there weren't enough games in October to tempt you, Final Fantasy Resonance is a pretty tempting offer for anyone looking to play an old-school JRPG that features an A-team of Final Fantasy guest characters. It also puts its own twist on Square Enix's HD-2D gameplay formula, as you can break past the barriers of traditional turn-based combat and take down even the spongiest of enemies--if you know how to properly set up all the moves you'll do. Play your cards right, and you can leave your team to dish out some tremendous damage for several minutes while you go brew yourself a fresh cup of coffee.

So what's happening here? To be fair, this is some real high-level gameplay, as GameSpot's video producer Max Blumenthal pushes gameplay mechanics like Visions, multi-action stacking, and ability carry-over skills t
title: Final Fantasy Resonance Lets You Take A Five-Minute Single Turn, And It’s Glorious

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
As more Grand Theft Auto 6 previews roll out, one topic seems to be proving pretty controversial among fans--the realistic need to refuel your vehicle. Some players think it's a little egregious of Rockstar to force you to hunt down gasoline, while others consider that because of the game's other realistic mechanisms--like relationships, working out, and escaping the police--that needing to refuel should have been introduced to the franchise a long while back.

While the details aren't concrete right now, we know there will be at least two types of cars--ones that need gasoline and electric vehicles. There may be some hybrid vehicles, but it hasn't been confirmed just yet.
title: How Will Gas And Refueling Work In GTA 6?

author: S.E. Doster
description:
We went hands-on with Modern Warfare 4 early, and while it will feel familiar to many Call of Duty veterans, Infinity Ward has updated some of the movement mechanics and features from recent years. In this guide, we'll provide some of the best tips to help you score wins in multiplayer when Modern Warfare 4 launches on October 23.

Practice the new movement

Modern Warfare 4 overhauls the movement from the last two years of
title: Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Tips For Multiplayer
